• Raag : Darbari Taal : Chautal
Amavasya or the no moon night holds significance in India. A night of meditation, gratitude and stillness, maestro Niladri Kumar explores the soulful sounds of the (The base sitar). This composition was played with his father Pandit Kartick Kumar, at the age of 15 and can be heard in the Album "where tradition meets innovation". In the album, the Taal is teentaal.
